caption: The drawing shows a rectangular garden plan divided into two main sections. The upper section consists of a green rectangular area featuring five horizontal rows of evenly spaced small green trees, each tree sitting above a patch of blue, likely representing water or shadow. At the top center, there is an ornamental element resembling a coat of arms: it features a green lion on a gray shield, topped with a gold ball and a laurel wreath, with the name "Jones" written underneath. Below the rows of trees, there is a horizontal line of small, round green shrubs or bushes which separates the upper and lower sections. The lower section is composed of four large square plots with stylized, symmetrical parterre patterns in green, red, pink, and yellow colors, bordered by tan walkways. Flanking the garden on the left is a row of small green bushes. Two small gray-roofed structures resembling pavilions are placed on the left side at junctions of the walkways near the lower section. The entire plan sits on a beige background with a thin blue border outlining the garden area. Handwritten text in pencil appears at the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Thomas Jones Estate
